high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the Instagram Reels section. The post features a person with a long white beard and a white turban, dressed in traditional attire that includes a white garment with intricate patterns and a gold-colored shawl draped over one shoulder. The individual appears to be speaking or presenting, as suggested by their posture and the context of the post. The text overlay on the image reads: "But a genius learns to do what is needed joyfully." This quote is attributed to Sadhguru, as indicated by the username "withsadhguru" at the bottom of the post.
